item.text: {"content":"The request contains no actual 2025 sales figures, monthly sales volumes, or profit margins, and the supplied tools cannot retrieve them. Creating the requested charts would require inventing data. Required inputs are provincial sales in millions RMB and January–December sales volumes and profit margins. Once available, the map can display all province subdivisions and highlight Guangdong, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Sichuan, with matching blue tones for the monthly combined chart.","tool_calls":[]}
